summary.headline: L&F CO.,LTD issues KRW 4bn 12th convertible bond, 0.0% coupon, private placement
summary.what_happened: On Nov 26, 2026, L&F CO.,LTD's board decided to issue its 12th unsecured, non-guaranteed private convertible bond with a total face value of KRW 4bn, to be placed with Paratus Value-Up Private Investment LP. The bond has a 0.0% coupon, a 3.0% guaranteed yield to maturity compounded quarterly, and matures on Dec 14, 2056; the subscription and payment dates are both Dec 14, 2026, and the conversion price is KRW 72,496 per share.

key_numbers.label: Coupon rate / guaranteed yield to maturity
Use of proceeds
key_numbers.value: KRW 4bn for operating funds (NCM and LFP cathode material business expansion)

summary.why_it_matters: Convertible bond issues can lead to new shares being issued if holders convert, which may dilute the ownership percentage of existing shareholders; the dilution depends on the number of shares issued relative to total shares outstanding. Terms such as early redemption options, interest deferral, and any conversion price adjustments set out in the filing determine how the bonds affect shareholders over time.
